29:15.text: But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it

29:16.text: Abraham, when he said to his people, "Worship Allāh and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know.

29:17.text: You only worship, besides Allāh, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides Allāh do not possess for you
provision. So seek from Allāh provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned."

29:18.text: - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except

29:19.text: Have they not considered how Allāh begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for Allāh, is easy.

29:20.text: , "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then Allāh will produce the final creation
. Indeed Allāh, over all things, is competent."

29:21.text: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned.

29:22.text: And you will not cause failure
upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allāh any protector or any helper.

29:23.text: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allāh and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.
